records.title: Make AI tools cheaper to run
records.reason: Several independent approaches reduce repeated information processing across AI workflows. The common customer expense and reusable software direction extend beyond a single project.

records.title: Testing suite for robot software
records.reason: Reusable tests address recurring software changes across robot teams; a credible product category rather than one benchmark.

records.title: Faster drone inspection maps
records.reason: Repeated survey-to-map delivery across infrastructure inspections has a common workflow and a usable software output.

records.title: Cheaper robot training data
records.reason: Demonstration collection, generated variation and evaluation are repeatable needs across robot tasks. Saved research includes actual category spending.

records.title: Factory robots with less setup
records.reason: Reducing reprogramming and adaptation when parts change is a recurring deployment constraint across factories.

records.title: Lightweight powered assistance for mobility
records.reason: Repeated mobility needs, powered-assistance mechanisms and existing commercial offers support a product category beyond one knee device.

records.title: Safer actions by AI assistants
records.reason: A reusable control layer could address consequential actions across connected business systems; multiple projects attempt parts of this capability.

records.title: Run repeated lab experiments with less manual work
records.reason: Make-measure-adjust loops recur in materials development, with documented manual work and an existing equipment/software budget category.

records.title: Find device-software faults using real hardware
records.reason: Testing and diagnosis recur across electronics makers. Connecting code, instruments and follow-up tests gives a defined product direction.

records.title: Turn drawings and measurements into checked part designs
records.reason: Reconstruction and correction recur across engineering and repair work; the capability is broader than one generated object.

records.title: Less manual handling in commercial laundries
records.reason: Recurring work, established equipment buyers and existing automation support a repeatable business category despite only one supporting corpus prototype.

records.title: Keep workers cooler while wearing protective gear
records.reason: Multiple projects address a shared constraint: workers cannot simply remove required clothing to cool down. The benefit extends beyond one vest.

records.title: Cyclist safety tests
records.reason: Vehicle scenarios are a specialized testing track with different buyers and requirements. The supporting projects have not demonstrated an integrated suite.

records.title: Safer inspection robots
records.reason: Site testing complements software tests. The underlying locomotion research does not itself establish a testing product.

records.title: A sensor-equipped test leg for wearable robots
records.reason: Fit and development tools, not evidence of walking benefit or a standalone testing market.

records.title: Inspection equipment that keeps factory production moving
records.reason: Coating, membrane and camera checks use different equipment. These briefs do not yet establish one repeatable solution.

records.title: Schedule AI training around electricity costs
records.reason: Computing operators must preserve job deadlines and account for the cost of idle hardware.

records.title: Move flexible electricity use to cheaper hours
records.reason: Fleet departures and building comfort impose different constraints and buying requirements.

records.title: Gesture controls for robots that provide physical help
records.reason: The evidence establishes a gesture interface and recorded human-operated tasks, not a broader capability that reliably reduces effort in independent assistance.

records.title: A portable cooler for blood transport in the field
records.reason: A real mission requirement and category research award support a useful specialized product, but the saved evidence does not connect this design to a repeatable large-business opportunity.

records.title: Reusable filters that release captured copper
records.reason: One material concept for household water; industrial transfer and improved full treatment economics remain untested.

records.title: A wearable cue for sudden walking freezes
records.reason: A detector and mechanical prompt address a defined symptom, but no patient benefit or evidence-backed expansion connects the project to a larger commercial capability.

groups.title: Lower energy costs by shifting flexible work
groups.summary: Schedule work for times when electricity costs less or the grid has spare capacity, while still meeting deadlines.
groups.boundary: Computing, fleets and buildings are separate customer tracks. They share an economic idea, not a proven common product or combined market.

groups.title: Less manual factory quality control
groups.summary: Manufacturers describe repeated inspection work and unreliable checks that interrupt production.
groups.boundary: Coating measurements, membrane tests and camera inspection need different equipment. This is a research area; a common repeatable product has not been established.
